Events

Annual Golf Outing

Event Details

  • Date/Time: Wednesday, October 7th, 2026 from 10:30 am to 7:30 pm
Metropolis Country Club
289 Dobbs Ferry Rd
White Plains, NY 10607

Join us on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 for our Annual Golf Outing!

Don’t miss out on a day of golfing under the sun, networking and connecting with industry professionals, dinner at the prestigious Metropolis Country Club, and a chance to win some amazing prizes at our raffle! You can help make our raffle prizes even better by donating. Contact Margie at margie@buildersinstitute.org if your business or organization would like to make a prize donation!

Tentative Schedule (subject to change closer to the date)

10:30 am to 12:00 noon — Registration and breakfast buffet

12:15 noon — Shotgun start

12:30 pm — Lunch available at the Halfway House

5:00 pm — Cocktail reception

6:00 pm — Dinner and prize raffle

REGISTER HERE!
